title: Modify Through a Reference
learning_objective: Understand that a non-const reference aliases an existing object instead of copying it.
instructions: Complete the program so modify changes value to 20 through a reference. The program must print 20.
hints: Passing an int by value creates a copy.
The function parameter needs to refer to the original int.
explanation: An int& parameter is a reference to the original object. Assigning 20 through the reference modifies value in main, so the program prints 20.
